deleteAccount.label: Delete account
deleteAccount.hint: Permanently deletes your account and all private data — profile, nutrition diary, weight history, and goals. Shared household data (e.g. the fridge inventory) remains for the other household members. If you are the last admin somewhere with other members, resolve that in the household settings first.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Your profile, nutrition diary, weight history, and goals will be permanently deleted. Shared household data remains for the other members. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.notYetPossibleBody: You are the last admin in at least one household with other members. Transfer the admin role there first, or delete the household in the member settings — then you can delete your account.

dataProtection.title: How your data is protected
dataProtection.body: There is no end-to-end encryption — the server needs to read data to filter it by household and sync it in real time. Instead: transport encryption (TLS), encryption at rest on the database level, and access separation via Row Level Security — personal health data (diary, weight, goals, profile) is not visible even to household admins. Access tokens live exclusively in the device's Keychain/Keystore.

dataProcessed.title: What data is processed
dataProcessed.body: Account (email), profile (display name, birth date, height, activity level), health/nutrition data (diary, weight, goals — private, not shared with the household), child profiles, household data (name, members, roles — shared with the household), fridge and shopping list data (shared with the household), product data (barcode, nutrition facts).

thirdParties.title: Third-party services
thirdParties.body: Open Food Facts: when scanning a barcode or searching for a product, the barcode/search term is sent to the public Open Food Facts API — without account or health data. Supabase hosts the database, authentication, and realtime sync. Google AdMob serves ads for the free version. RevenueCat handles purchase and subscription status. Sentry, PostHog, and Aptabase help with error diagnosis, product improvement, and usage analytics.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Camera: barcode scanning and QR code join (optional, manual entry always works). Notifications: local reminder before a fridge item expires (optional). Location and photo library are only requested for their respective features. The microphone is only technically provided in the camera context and is not used for advertising.

adsAndTracking.title: Ads and tracking
adsAndTracking.body: The free version uses Google AdMob. On iOS we ask for app tracking permission before showing personalized ads. If you decline, the app can still show non-personalized or limited ads. You can change your choice via the ad settings.

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.body: Access/export via Settings → Export as JSON. Deletion via Settings → Delete account — shared household data remains for the remaining members, only your private data is removed. Profile and diary data can be edited directly in the app.
